intro.title: From a complete solution to a single component.
intro.body: Veranda fits the way you build. Launch a ready-to-run program, put our technology inside your own product, or add a single lock or sensor to the systems you already run.

models.title: Five ways to build on Veranda
models.body: Each model is a different split between what we provide and what you bring. Choose the one that matches how much you want to build, or start a conversation and we’ll help you decide.

items.title: Complete solution
items.body: The fastest route to a live program. Veranda delivers the enclosure, hardware, software, and support as one system, so your team runs the program instead of building the technology.
items.fit: Organizations launching a delivery or access program without building the system themselves.

proof.label: See it in the field: Dion’s Chicago Dream

items.title: White label
items.body: A proven product under your name. Take Veranda-powered hardware and apps to market with your branding, in a fraction of the time it takes to develop your own.
items.fit: Companies that want a field-ready product to sell as their own.

items.title: Custom development
items.body: Built around your requirements. When nothing off the shelf fits, our engineers work alongside yours on custom hardware, software, and workflows, from prototype through production.
items.fit: Products with requirements that no off-the-shelf solution meets.

items.title: Technology licensing
items.body: Veranda inside your product line. License the hardware designs and software platform to ship access, monitoring, and automation as features of products you already sell.
items.fit: Product makers adding intelligent access to an existing line.

items.title: Component integration
items.body: Fill a gap without replacing a system. Add a single lock or sensor board, or connect one software service, to what you already run.
items.fit: Teams with working systems that are missing one capability.
bring: The gap to fill: a lock, a sensor, or a service

growth.title: Any of these can grow into a longer-term relationship.
growth.body: Over time, partnerships can span distribution, programs, and joint product roadmaps.

steps.title: Initial discussion
steps.body: Your product, operation, and what you want to achieve.

steps.title: Requirements & fit
steps.body: Which parts of the platform apply, and how.

steps.title: Evaluation
steps.body: Hands-on testing with an Evaluation Kit.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: A scoped deployment in real conditions.

steps.title: Integration or deployment
steps.body: Rolling out into your product or program.

considerations.title: What we’ll explore together
considerations.body: Every engagement is shaped by a handful of practical questions. We work through them with you early, so the evaluation and pilot answer the right ones.

items.title: Product & operational requirements
items.question: What does your product or operation need access control, monitoring, and automation to do?

items.title: Enclosure & hardware integration
items.question: Does the hardware go into our reference enclosure, or into one of your own?

items.title: Sensors & connectivity
items.question: Which conditions need monitoring, and how far does the signal need to reach? Bluetooth works up close, LoRaWAN over long range.

items.title: Branding
items.question: Does the product carry the Veranda name, or yours?

items.title: Software requirements
items.question: Which of your systems should access events reach? The REST API, SDKs, and webhooks connect to dispatch, ordering, or property systems.

items.title: Support responsibilities
items.question: Who supports the hardware, the software, and the end customer, and where does that line sit?

items.title: Commercial structure
items.question: What terms fit, from the first pilot to a long-term relationship?

cta.title: Find the right fit, hands-on.
cta.body: Request an Evaluation Kit to test Veranda in your own product, or tell us what you’re building and we’ll set up a partnership discussion.
